checks.name: assumptions_sourced
checks.detail: 22 assumptions, each with a source and kind

weather_options.recession: Jobs are harder to keep and markets fall: job-loss probability x3, no real wage growth, portfolio returns 15 points/year lower during the window.
weather_options.inflation: Prices rise faster than planned while wages keep their usual pace: purchasing power drops.
weather_options.market_crash: Invested savings lose a share of their value in one month, then markets behave as usual.
weather_options.job_loss: Income stops for a few months; unemployment insurance replaces part of it (see assumption AS-unemployment-replacement).

assumptions.label: Average annual inflation (CPI)
assumptions.source: FSO Swiss Consumer Price Index (https://www.bfs.admin.ch/bfs/en/home/statistics/prices/consumer-price-index.html) and SNB price-stability definition 0-2% (https://www.snb.ch)

assumptions.label: Year-to-year volatility of inflation
assumptions.source: Order of magnitude of Swiss CPI annual changes 2000-2025, FSO (same link as AS-inflation-mean)

assumptions.label: Real wage growth per year (on top of inflation)
assumptions.source: FSO Swiss Wage Index (https://www.bfs.admin.ch/bfs/en/home/statistics/work-income/wages-income-employment-labour-costs/wage-index.html); young workers usually progress faster than the average

assumptions.label: Expected annual return of a balanced portfolio (nominal, after fees)
assumptions.source: Long-run Swiss equity/bond returns, Pictet 'Performance of Swiss shares and bonds since 1926' (annual study, https://www.group.pictet); 50/50 mix minus ~0.5% fees

assumptions.label: Annual volatility of the balanced portfolio
assumptions.source: Same Pictet study: equities ~15-18%, bonds ~4%, 50/50 mix ~10%

assumptions.label: Interest on positive cash (savings account)
assumptions.source: SNB policy rate at 0% (https://www.snb.ch); Swiss retail savings accounts pay roughly 0.1-0.5%

assumptions.label: Probability of losing the job in a given year
assumptions.source: Swiss registered unemployment ~2.5-3% (SECO, https://www.amstat.ch); inflow probability taken of the same order

assumptions.label: Average length of an unemployment spell
assumptions.source: SECO labour market statistics (https://www.amstat.ch): average registered duration of a few months up to a year

assumptions.label: Share of income kept while unemployed (unemployment insurance)
assumptions.source: Swiss unemployment insurance pays 70% of the insured salary (80% with dependants) after 12 months of contributions (https://www.arbeit.swiss). Students without contributions get 0

assumptions.label: Probability per year of an unexpected expense (health, repairs, family)
assumptions.source: Modelling choice (no source); illustrates that budgets get surprises

assumptions.label: Average size of an unexpected expense
assumptions.source: Modelling choice: about one month of a student's expenses; e.g. Swiss health insurance deductible is CHF 300-2,500 (https://www.bag.admin.ch)

assumptions.label: Income tax level (1 = illustrative Lausanne table)
assumptions.table_unit: [annual net salary CHF (after social contributions, at today's prices), effective rate]
assumptions.source: Simplified effective federal+cantonal+communal rate, single person, Lausanne (VD), no church tax, read off the ESTV tax calculator (https://swisstaxcalculator.estv.admin.ch). Income in profiles is net of social contributions and before income tax

assumptions.label: Sell investments automatically when cash goes negative (1 = yes)
assumptions.source: Modelling rule: a shortfall is first covered by selling investments; any remaining negative cash is an unfunded financing need (not an assumed loan)

assumptions.label: Emergency reserve considered healthy
assumptions.source: Common budgeting rule of thumb: 3-6 months of expenses (e.g. Swiss debt-counselling Budgetberatung Schweiz, https://www.budgetberatung.ch)

assumptions.label: Debt payments above this share of income are considered stretched
assumptions.source: Swiss mortgage affordability rule of thumb: housing costs <= 1/3 of gross income (illustrative, not a lending policy)

assumptions.label: Net salary if she starts working now
assumptions.source: UBS LauzHack starter kit scenario_config.json ('Start working'), illustrative

assumptions.label: Rent of a studio in Lausanne
assumptions.source: Starter kit total expenses CHF 3,000 split by the team into rent + other; FSO average rents by canton (https://www.bfs.admin.ch) to verify

assumptions.label: Master's tuition and study costs per year
assumptions.source: UBS starter kit (CHF 2,500 at months 0 and 12). Low end: EPFL fee CHF 730/semester for Swiss students (https://www.epfl.ch). High end: UBS synthetic scenario-assumptions.csv annual_tuition_chf=8000 for P00001

assumptions.label: Student job income during the master's
assumptions.source: UBS starter kit ('Master's degree' phase 1) and synthetic-profiles.csv reference income

assumptions.label: Net salary after the master's
assumptions.source: UBS starter kit ('Master's degree' phase 2), illustrative

assumptions.label: Net salary abroad (converted to CHF)
assumptions.source: UBS starter kit ('Move abroad'), illustrative; exchange rate held constant

assumptions.label: One-off cost of moving abroad
assumptions.source: UBS starter kit ('Move abroad' one-off cost)
